title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
description: Discover the functional student hubs and quiet corners of Centre College, from historic warehouse hangouts to modern collaborative labs and late-night study lounges.

cards.title: Collaborative Hub in Crounse Hall
cards.subtitle: Grace Doherty Library Main Floor
cards.notes: Visit this tech-savvy space for peer tutoring or group projects. It is located right next to Einstein Bros. Bagels for easy caffeine access during long study sessions.
cards.short_summary: A modern collaborative study area with peer tutoring and seminar rooms located inside the main library.
cards.evidence_claim: The Centre Learning Commons is located on the main floor of the Grace Doherty Library in Crounse Hall and includes spaces for individual and group study.
cards.access_notes: Open during Grace Doherty Library hours of operation; accessible to all students.

cards.title: Student Recreation and Billiards
cards.subtitle: Roush Campus Center
cards.notes: Check out pool balls or ping pong paddles at the Information Desk with your student ID. It is a popular spot for a quick break between classes or evening relaxation.
cards.short_summary: A central campus recreation space featuring pool tables and ping pong for student use.
cards.evidence_claim: Students can play pool and ping pong in the Campus Center by checking out equipment from the Information Desk with a photo ID.
cards.access_notes: Common areas are accessible 24 hours a day via student card swipe.

cards.title: Historic Hemp Warehouse Hangout
cards.subtitle: The Warehouse
cards.notes: Reserve the first floor for student events or meetings. This 1902 former hemp warehouse offers a unique industrial atmosphere for campus gatherings.
cards.short_summary: A renovated historic warehouse used for student meetings, recreation, and campus events.
cards.evidence_claim: The Combs Activities Center, known as the Warehouse, provides recreation, meeting space, and event space for the Centre community.
cards.access_notes: First floor available for student reservations via the Event Centre portal.

cards.title: Late Night Cardio and Weights
cards.subtitle: Sutcliffe Hall
cards.notes: Use your student ID for swipe access until midnight. The facility includes a cardio deck, weight room, and racquetball courts for all-day fitness.
cards.short_summary: The primary campus fitness facility offering extended hours for student workouts.
cards.evidence_claim: The Buck Fitness Center is open to Centre students with swipe card access from 5:00 am to 12:00 am daily.
cards.access_notes: Open daily until midnight; requires student ID for card swipe entry.

cards.title: STEM Study Nooks
cards.subtitle: Franklin W. Olin Hall
cards.notes: Find quiet study spots and innovative collaboration areas tucked between science labs. It is ideal for group work in chemistry or computer science.
cards.short_summary: Modern student-faculty collaborative spaces and quiet study areas within the science building.
cards.evidence_claim: Olin Hall features classrooms, faculty offices, and student/faculty collaborative spaces designed for optimal learning.
cards.access_notes: Accessible during academic building hours; primarily used by science and math students.

cards.title: Gold LEED Social Space
cards.subtitle: Pearl Hall Main Floor
cards.notes: Relax in the spacious main floor lounge or use the outdoor patio with a fire pit and grill. This LEED Gold certified building is a favorite for upperclassmen.
cards.short_summary: A high-efficiency social lounge and outdoor gathering area in a modern residence hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Pearl Hall features a spacious lounge on the main floor for social gatherings and a large patio area with a fire pit and grill.
cards.access_notes: Main lounge accessible to residents; common areas often host student life events.

cards.title: World-Class Shows for Free
cards.subtitle: Norton Center for the Arts
cards.notes: Scan your student ID at the Box Office starting at 6:30 p.m. on show nights for free admission. Arrive early as these limited tickets go fast.
cards.short_summary: A program providing Centre students free access to professional touring performances and concerts.
cards.evidence_claim: Centre students receive free tickets to Norton Center performances by scanning in at the Box Office beginning at 6:30 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Available on performance nights; student ID required for ticket pickup.

cards.title: Evening S'mores and Socials
cards.subtitle: Brockman Residential Commons
cards.notes: Gather at the courtyard fire pit for marshmallows and socializing. It is a key outdoor spot for upperclassmen living in the townhouse-style apartments.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor social hub featuring a fire pit and grill area for student gatherings.
cards.evidence_claim: The Brockman Commons courtyard includes a fire-pit perfect for roasting marshmallows and socializing, plus an outdoor covered grill area.
cards.source_title: The A. Eugene Brockman Commons - Centre College
cards.access_notes: Outdoor courtyard is accessible to the campus community.

cards.title: Modern Science Lounge
cards.subtitle: Young Hall
cards.notes: Study in the open common areas of this Gold LEED building. The light-filled lobby and collaborative research labs provide a professional academic environment.
cards.short_summary: Sustainable and modern common areas designed for student-faculty collaborative research.
cards.evidence_claim: Young Hall features several new common areas to support student-faculty collaborative research and is Gold LEED certified.
cards.access_notes: Open during academic hours; common areas available for student study.

cards.title: Quiet Research and Printing
cards.subtitle: Grace Doherty Library
cards.notes: Head to the lower level for a 30-station computer lab and quiet research zones. It is often less crowded than the main floor Learning Commons.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated computer lab and quiet study zone located on the library's lower level.
cards.evidence_claim: A computer lab equipped with 30 desktop computers is available for research instruction and student use on the lower level of the library.
cards.access_notes: Open during library hours; lower level is typically a designated quiet zone.
